candidates.snippet: 1907: Graduation from Harvard Law - Franklin D. Roosevelt graduated from Harvard Law School, marking a significant step in his early legal and political career. 1910: Elected to New York State Senate - Roosevelt was elected to the New York State Senate, beginning his significant career in state politics. 1913: Appointed Assistant Secretary of the Navy - He was appointed Assistant Secretary of the Navy, serving during a critical period of naval expansion and World War I. 1928: Elected Governor of New York - Roosevelt was elected Governor of New York, a position from which he would later launch his presidential campaign.
